verdict.rationale: Navan documents a real API for the expense surface: retrieval and batch-update endpoints for transactions, custom-field management, receipts, users, accounting settings and webhooks. It also offers a hosted MCP server, but that is framed around querying spend and travel data. There is no evidence of API parity for core UI capabilities such as booking or changing travel, issuing reimbursements, or managing policy and approval workflows, so full UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: travel booking and changes via API, policy and approval workflow management via API, card issuance or management writes, an explicit statement of UI/API parity, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
